يختلسان (form VIII)
# يَخْتَلِسَانِ (yaḵtalisāni) /jax.ta.li.saː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# يُخْتَلَسَانِ (yuḵtalasāni) /jux.ta.la.saː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
